review_round_1.1_validationfailed: Done. Rule: ValidationFailed<X> written as "type":"ValidationFailed<X>" (generic leaves carry type-argument wire names) and read back as the closed type (X = Error, registered key or leaf). The preferred 'enclosing TError' rule can't work: Validation<T,X>.ToResult() returns Result<T> (TError = Error). Written/read by hand; closed type built via MakeGenericType/Array.CreateInstance (reference types; one IL3050 suppression; verified by native AOT publish). Tests: Validation_ToResult_round_trips_for_every_element_type, unregistered element, element outside type, registering closed type harmless; generators extended (RoundTripLaws Errors(depth) + Result_from_a_Validation_of_a_hierarchy).
review_round_1.2_duplicates: Done. Repeated envelope members (ok/value/error/errors) and repeated top-level error-object members always throw JsonException, whatever AllowDuplicateProperties says. JsonNode is gone from reading, so no ArgumentException path remains. Tests in ReadTests.
review_round_1.3_message: Done: message must be a string; context array of strings if present; cause object/null/absent.
review_round_1.4_hierarchy_member: Done: NestedErrorConverter (non-generic JsonConverter<Error>, cast by STJ) accepts any abstract Error subtype with registry candidates. PaymentFailed(int, PaymentError) leaf tested in wire, read and laws; works under native AOT.
review_round_1.5_performance: Candidates cached per (options, declared, explicit cases) in a WireCache (CWT); Errors name cached; base-name detection moved into a resolver modifier (once per type, cached by STJ); reading streams from Utf8JsonReader with no JsonNode/DeepClone. Remaining cost: each level's Scan skips its subtree, so a cause chain of depth d scans O(d^2) tokens without allocating.

decisions_rows: 12b | A ValidationFailed<X> is written as "type":"ValidationFailed<X>" (X = its type argument's wire name) and read back as that closed type when X is Error, an AddErrorCases key or a registered leaf; unknown X -> JsonException. Validation<T, X>.ToResult() round-trips for every X. Any generic leaf's type carries its type arguments. | The enclosing TError can't pick it: ToResult returns Result<T> (TError = Error)

12b, 20a, 22 | AddResultful and ResultfulJsonConverterFactory need dynamic code ([RequiresDynamicCode]). 20a's registration does not call AddResultful. AOT (22) uses an IJsonTypeInfoResolver returning JsonMetadataServices.CreateValueInfo per result type, combined with the source-generated context via JsonTypeInfoResolver.Combine, plus AddErrorCases; AOT code serializes through options.GetTypeInfo | Review of #48

12b | Repeated members in the envelope and in an error object always throw JsonException, whatever AllowDuplicateProperties says; message must be a string, context an array of strings, cause an object/null/absent | Review of #48
